'''Buzz''' was a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until [[3641 BBY]] when the crime lord [[Ivory]] arranged an escape of himself and his associates, including Buzz. Along with [[Squarg]], Buzz was attempting to free [[Agrular]] from [[Cell block 2018]] when both were interrupted by the [[Voidhound]] and subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]].
